title: First Fort Dearborn gains galleries and detailed barrack fronts
items: Five first-fort barrack ranges gain two-storey galleries, Whistler’s opening patterns and source-counted stacks; two blockhouses lose invented chimneys. Picture matches remain unresolved.
Four declared Kinzie poplars and six Ouilmette currants render with the existing collision clearance; their source counts remain unchanged.
Light and Full detail reach the northern 1812 woodland below the existing tree caps without thinning declared plants.
